Normalize routing and role boundaries first, including dispatch_implement_agent / dispatch_plan_agent and review success completion behavior.
Tighten skill and bash allowlists per subagent, then rewrite evidence-envelope and handoff/raw-log requirements with valid JSON examples.
Run static prompt checks and workflow-contract verification before sign-off.
